decisive_spans.text: Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT revealed a well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass measuring 6×5 cm with fat attenuation in the antropyloric region

response.rationale: The CT findings of a well-defined, heterogeneous mass with fat attenuation are highly specific for Lipoma. While Peptic ulcer disease is supported by symptoms and ulceration, it does not explain the mass with fat attenuation. GIST is contradicted by the biopsy showing no malignant features.
